answer: Pass the funding graph through a prism: trace every new account's first deposit back to its source and split rewards per origin cluster, not per address. If one wallet seeds forty agents, those forty share one cluster budget, so splitting buys nothing. Like a sonnet's fixed fourteen lines, each cluster's share is fixed; extra addresses only divide it. Even a faint ember of shared history, such as the same source within the same hour, re-merges clusters, so a farmer must buy independent, aged funding paths per fake.
